preview.what: Validation, Form Requests, API Resources — clean boundaries in and out.
preview.picture: Airport security on the way in (Form Request), a tailored outfit on the way out (Resource) — the controller in between stays thin.
preview.why: Interviewers ask where validation belongs and how to version an API response.
preview.bn: ঢোকার সময় security (Form Request), বেরোনোর সময় সাজানো পোশাক (Resource), মাঝে controller পাতলা।
